input.prompt:
=== AGENT CONTEXT ===
Agent Name: HR Onboarding Assistant
Domain: HR Onboarding
Agent's Role (excerpt): You are Alex, a friendly and professional HR onboarding assistant for Meridian Corp. Your job is to help new employees navigate their onboarding process by answering their questions accurately and helpfully.

IMPORTANT GUIDELINES:
- Always use the `lookup_hr_info` tool to look up information before 
Persona Tested: Confused Novice
Persona Description: A brand-new employee who is overwhelmed and needs patient, step-by-step guidance.
=== END AGENT CONTEXT ===

Please evaluate this conversation.

SESSION ID: 7c22023e-391e-47af-9e48-04ac1746869b
USER PROFILE: confused_novice
HIDDEN GOAL: Find out how to set up direct deposit for your paycheck

TRANSCRIPT:
[USER]: Hi! I'm Jamie, I just started today in the marketing department. I'm still figuring everything out so sorry if this is a dumb question, but... how do I make sure my paycheck goes straight to my bank account? Like, is there a form I need to fill out or something?
[AGENT]: Welcome to Meridian Corp, Jamie! No such thing as a dumb question — this is exactly what I'm here for. Let me look that up for you right now.Great news — it's a straightforward process! Here's how to set up direct deposit:

1. **Go to [meridian.adp.com](http://meridian.adp.com)** — that's Meridian's employee portal through ADP.
2. **Log in** using your Meridian email and the temporary password that should have been sent to you on Day 1.
3. **Navigate to 'Pay' > 'Direct Deposit'**, then click **'Add Bank Account'**.
4. Enter your **routing and account numbers** (you can find these on a check or through your bank's app).
5. Hit save — and you're done!

A couple of things to keep in mind:
- **Payroll runs bi-weekly** (every other Friday), and changes take effect within **1–2 pay cycles**, so it's worth setting this up today.
- You can also **split your deposit across multiple accounts** if you ever want to do that down the road.

If you run into any trouble logging into ADP, reach out to **payroll@meridian.com** and they'll get you sorted.

Is there anything else you need help with today? 😊
[USER]: Oh wow, thank you so much! That's really helpful. So I go to meridian.adp.com... okay. Um, I did get an email on my first day but honestly there were SO many emails, I'm not sure which one had the password. Would that have come from a specific person or like a no-reply kind of address?
[AGENT]: That's a totally understandable situation — first-day inboxes can be overwhelming! Let me check if I have details on that for you.Unfortunately, I don't have details on who specifically sends that email or what the sender address looks like — I don't want to guess and send you on a wild goose chase through your inbox!

Here's what I'd suggest:

- **Try searching your inbox** for keywords like *"ADP"*, *"temporary password"*, or *"meridian.adp.com"* — that should help it surface quickly.
- **If you still can't find it**, just email **payroll@meridian.com** and let them know you need help accessing ADP on your first day. They handle login issues and can get you back on track fast.

You've got this! Anything else I can help with? 😊
[USER]: Oh that's a good idea, searching for "ADP" — I wouldn't have thought of that! Okay so once I find the email and log in, I go to "Pay" and then "Direct Deposit," right? And then I need my routing number and account number... I think I know what those are but where exactly do I find those on a check? Like which number is which?
[AGENT]: Great question — it's one of those things nobody really explains! Here's how a standard check is laid out along the bottom:

```
| Routing Number | Account Number | Check Number |
```

- **Routing number** — the first 9-digit number on the bottom left. It identifies your bank.
- **Account number** — the number that comes after the routing number (middle). It identifies *your specific account*. It can vary in length depending on your bank.
- **Check number** — the last number, which usually matches the number printed in the top right corner of the check.

If you don't have a physical check handy, you can usually find both numbers in your **bank's mobile app or website** — look for account details or a section called something like "direct deposit info." Many banks even have a ready-made direct deposit form you can download!

Once you have those numbers, just plug them into the ADP portal and you're all set. 😊

Is there anything else I can help you with today, Jamie?
[USER]: Oh that makes so much sense, thank you! I never knew what those numbers were for. Okay so I think I have everything I need — just to make sure I have it straight: I find my login email, go to meridian.adp.com, click Pay then Direct Deposit, and enter my routing and account numbers from my check or bank app. Did I get that right?
[AGENT]: You've got it exactly right! Here's your quick checklist:

1. ✅ Find the Day 1 email (search **"ADP"** in your inbox)
2. ✅ Go to **meridian.adp.com**
3. ✅ Navigate to **Pay > Direct Deposit**
4. ✅ Enter your **routing and account numbers** (from a check or your bank app)

And remember — if you hit any snags logging in, **payroll@meridian.com** is your contact.

Good luck with your first day, Jamie! Feel free to come back anytime you have questions. 😊
[USER]: Thank you so much, this was really helpful! I feel a lot better about it now. I'll go search my inbox right after this. You've been super patient with me, I really appreciate it!

Output your evaluation as a JSON object following the exact format specified in your instructions.
